definitionYaml:
version: "1.0"
name: "single_model_evidence_gate"
description: "Profile B: evidence pack + deterministic contract gate"
inputs:
  optional:
    - evidence_pack
outputs:
  decision:
    type: object
states:
  - id: PROPOSE
    initial: true
  - id: CLOSED
    terminal: true
transitions:
  - from: PROPOSE
    to: CLOSED
    trigger: propose_done
    guards:
      - g_propose
steps:
  - id: propose
    state: PROPOSE
    handler: primary_b
    config:
      agent_kind: vllm
      provider.model: "qwen3-coder-30b"
      provider.max_tokens: 1536
      provider.timeout_secs: 300
      see_prior: false
      num_agents: 1
      output_contract:
        contract_id: evidence-bound-decision
        format: json_object
        required_fields: [claims, decision]
        allowed_values:
          decision: [accept, reject, request_changes, request_more_evidence]
        evidence:
          claims_field: claims
          refs_field: evidence_refs
          allowed_refs_from_context: evidence_pack
      prompt: "You are the primary engineer reviewing a technical decision for the Underpass Choreographer platform. QUESTION: Should model responses in ceremonies be persisted raw, summarized, or both? Decide: accept (both raw and summarized), reject (raw only), request_changes (summarized only) or request_more_evidence.\nEVIDENCE PACK (the ONLY citable evidence; cite by id in evidence_refs):\n- [ev-t4-loki-raw-value] The full decision timeline of run csi-typha-appeal-1 was reconstructed from raw Loki logs after the GPU worker was stopped: 78 events including every draft, all 12 peer critiques with round numbers, and every validator verdict. Raw persistence made the reconstruction possible.\n- [ev-t4-preview-truncation] Engine logs store proposal previews truncated (content_preview), not full outputs; the full winner content only travels in the RunCeremony response. A consumer that discards that response loses the only complete copy.\n- [ev-t4-storage-cost] The complete evidence of a 31-LLM-call ceremony (78 log events + 8 spans + response JSON) measures in the tens of kilobytes; the GPU compute that produced it ran for ~3.5 minutes on two nodes. Evidence storage cost is negligible relative to compute.\n- [ev-t4-summary-drift-risk] Runs csi-typha-1 and appeal (real) showed models summarizing prior context with drift and fabrication (a summary asserted 'privileged:true' that no source contained). LLM-generated summaries are lossy AND can introduce false statements.\n- [ev-t4-pii-surface] Raw persistence increases the audit surface: full outputs may contain sensitive fragments of prompts/evidence; summaries can redact. Retention policy applies to whichever form is kept.\nEvery claim MUST cite at least one evidence id from the pack in its evidence_refs; claims you cannot support, leave out. CRITICAL OUTPUT FORMAT: your ENTIRE response must be raw JSON — the first character of your response must be { and the last must be }. NEVER wrap it in ``` fences. Shape: {\"claims\": [{\"text\": \"...\", \"evidence_refs\": [\"ev-...\"]}], \"decision\": \"accept|reject|request_changes|request_more_evidence\", \"risks\": [\"...\"], \"assumptions\": [\"...\"]}"
guards:
  g_propose:
    type: automated
    check: "step_status:propose:COMPLETED"
roles:
  - id: PRIMARY_ENGINEER
    allowed_actions:
      - propose
      - propose_done
timeouts:
  step_default: 600
retry_policies:
  default:
    max_attempts: 2
    backoff_seconds: 2
